comment: Independent C-first dogmove.c quickmimic mounted pet branch. Source 1478-1488 dismounts a steed with DISMOUNT_POLY before appearance changes; dog_eat reaches it via m_consume_obj on a mimic corpse. Generate a tame saddled carnivorous gray dragon and scout its placement before mounting. Earlier hero-eats-mimic and leashed-dog cases have different caller/state. Own C scout places gray dragon northeast of hero, hero (52,16), dragon (53,15), and small-mimic corpse i. Dismiss inventory, use #ride northeast and answer the source force-mount question yes, then drop i on the mounted steed tile. Require actual steed eating and forced dismount before appearance change. C-only direction correction: exact expanded C glyph coordinates put the gray dragon (52,15), directly north of hero (52,16). The northeast attempt found nobody; retain it and mount north instead.
